name: dsh-codex-session-deletetool
description: Real conversation delete for the Codex UI sidebar: provides remote.workspaceRegistry.deleteSession so @michengai/dsh-codex-ui's own session menu grows its 删除会话 row, restores the row's ⋯ button, and asks before removing a conversation that carries subagent sessions or forked conversations. Ships its own Host delete engine derived from better-dsh-session-deletetool, so it works on its own. / 给 Codex UI 侧边栏补上真正的删除对话：提供 remote.workspaceRegistry.deleteSession，让 Codex UI 自己的会话菜单重新出现「删除会话」，同时修好会话行上被隐藏的「⋯」按钮；会话带着子智能体或派生对话时会先弹家族树确认。内置改编自 better-dsh-session-deletetool 的 Host 删除引擎，可独立工作。
author: memoryovo

meta.title: Codex UI 会话删除 / Codex UI Session Delete
meta.description: 给 Codex UI 的会话菜单补回「删除会话」：不是归档隐藏，而是删掉会话日志、工程记录与投影缓存；会话带着子智能体会话或派生对话时，先按层级列出来让你勾选，运行中的工作也会标出来。顺手修好被 Codex UI 自己藏掉的「⋯」按钮，右键与三个小点两条路都能调出同一个菜单。
